output.scope_note: The paper is mainly about resistive switching from electronic conductivity changes in amorphous LLTO, which is excluded, but it quotes one literature ionic conductivity for LLTO, a Li-ion solid electrolyte, so it is kept with a single literature_cited record.

records.evidence_quote: LLTO possesses higher ionic conductivity (~10-3 S/cm) than a conventional thin film solid state electrolyte
records.notes: Literature value quoted from the authors' earlier PLD work (ref. 45), not measured in this paper; no measurement temperature given. The paper's own measured conductivities are electronic and are excluded. The abstract gives the same ~10-3 S/cm figure without a citation.
